Class BuildingCard

java.lang.Object
model.cards.Card
model.cards.buildingCards.BuildingCard
public class BuildingCard extends Card
Represents a specific type of card that allows players to construct buildings.

Building cards carry a base economic cost (food) and grant both static end-game prestige points and dynamic gameplay effects. This class delegates its actual mechanical impact on the game state to an injected BuildingEffect implementation.

  • Constructor Details

    • BuildingCard

      public BuildingCard(int id, Era era, int playercount, int foodCost, int endGamePoints, BuildingEffect effect, String imagePath, String backImagePath)
      Constructs a new BuildingCard with the specified structural, economic, and functional attributes.
      Parameters:
      id - the unique sequential identifier assigned by the factory
      era - the chronological Era this card belongs to
      playercount - the minimum number of players required to include this card in the active game deck
      foodCost - the base amount of food resources required to acquire this building
      endGamePoints - the flat prestige points awarded to the owner at the end of the game
      effect - the instantiated polymorphic BuildingEffect bound to this card
      imagePath - the resource path for the card's front graphical asset
      backImagePath - the resource path for the card's back graphical asset

      public void registerToTribe(Player player)

      For a BuildingCard, this operation explicitly adds the instance to the player's building collection and triggers BuildingEffect.registerSelf(Player) to bind the functional rules (immediate, event-driven, or end-game) to the player's state.

    • getDiscountedCost

      public int getDiscountedCost(Player player)
      Calculates the dynamic food cost of this building card relative to a specific player's state.

      The final transaction cost is determined by subtracting the player's total accumulated builder discounts from the building's base food cost. The resulting cost is clamped to a strictly non-negative integer.

      Parameters:
      player - the Player attempting to calculate the purchase cost
      Returns:
      the fully discounted, non-negative food cost required to acquire the building
